guia.titulo: How to report in Rádix — step by step
guia.oQueFalar: What to say into the mic

inicio.texto: The record has 5 sections, always in the same order. The highlighted section is where you are — and where your speech goes. The dot trail shows what is done (green ✓) and what is left.
inicio.fazer1: Click the mic (or Alt+V), speak and click again.
inicio.fazer2: Use ↓ ↑ (or ▼ ▲) to move between sections. Click each section’s “?” for examples.
inicio.fazer3: If a section has nothing, click (or say) “Nothing to record”. Nothing is left blank by accident.
inicio.dica: Voice never guesses: similar words appear under “Doubts” for you to confirm. Approval is always manual.

dados.texto: Identify the radiograph and confirm it is anonymized.
dados.fazer1: Check the image: no name, birth date or other patient data.
dados.fazer2: Tick anonymization (or say “ok”). Teeth are clicked directly on the chart.

erro_tecnico.texto: Only errors possible for the chosen exam type are shown.

descricao.texto: The text students will read. Explain what the image teaches.
descricao.dica: Use macros (⚡) for repeated descriptions; then adjust.

observacoes.texto: Notes for the team (not shown to students).

aprovar.texto: When all 5 sections are ✓, click Approve. An automatic check runs: required items block approval; warnings can be reviewed or approved anyway.
aprovar.fazer1: Check the list shown and use “go to section” to fix.
aprovar.fazer2: After approving, the next image opens at step 1.
aprovar.falar1: save (saves the draft; approving is always with the mouse)

achados.texto: Each lesion marked on the image is a finding. The marking image opens automatically here.
achados.fazer1: Draw an oval, rectangle or arrow on each lesion.
achados.fazer2: For each number, choose the finding and fill in tooth and region.

Voz.rodape: Saved as draft • approving stays manual
Voz.indisponivel: Voice service unavailable. Check that the radix-whisper container is running.

Voz.ajuda2: Findings: “one periapical lesion on tooth 36”. Normal: “no changes”.
Voz.ajuda3: Technical error: “cone cut”; or “no technical error”.
Voz.ajuda4: Each field keyword (🎤) appears in the highlighted section.
Voz.ajuda5: Running text: “descrição: …”, “achados detalhados: …”, “observações internas: …” — ends with “fim”.
Voz.ajuda6: Commands: “undo”, “save”, “correct tooth 36 to 46”, “delete description”, “next section”, “previous section”, “nothing to record”.
Voz.ajuda7: Similar words (likely transcription errors) are NOT filled automatically: they appear under “Doubts” for one-click confirmation — and you can teach the system.
Voz.ajuda8: Highlighted section (right column): speech without a guide word goes there — in Description, Detailed findings or Notes it becomes text; in Markings, “two caries” is enough. “Next section” / “previous section” move the highlight.
Voz.aprendido: Learned: “{frase}” will be recognized next time.
Voz.duvidas: Doubts ({quantidade}) — confirm before they enter the record
Voz.ajuda9: Macros: “macro normal periapical” applies the saved template (⚡ Macros menu).

Macros.subtitulo: Team templates that fill description, findings, notes, changes, type and quality at once. Use the ⚡ Macros menu in Curation or say “macro <name>”. Applying a macro only fills the draft — approval stays manual.
Macros.dicaNome: Use short names that are easy to say.
Macros.frasesSubtitulo: When a curator confirms a doubt with “Remember”, the heard phrase starts to count as the chosen change.
